title: Homeowner Contract Terms: Discovery Share of a Line-Set Change Order on Replacement System Installations
content:
# Discovery share of a line-set change order

## Clause

The discovery share of a line-set change order on a Replacement System Installations project depends on when the homeowner confirmed its change-order approval, the most recent change-order approval confirmed on the project:

- confirmed on or after the day the project was scheduled, which is the day its permit-fee charge was posted, the line-set change order is charged at 60 percent;
- confirmed after the signing date and before the project was scheduled, or on a project not yet scheduled, at 80 percent;
- confirmed on the signing date itself, at 100 percent.

## Dates compared

| Date | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Approval date | The most recent change-order approval request on the project with confirmed status |
| Scheduling date | The posting date of the project's permit-fee charge |
| Signing date | The project's signing date |

## Decision table

| Approval confirmed | Project scheduled at that point | Discovery share |
|---|---|---|
| On the signing date | — | 100 percent |
| After the signing date | Not yet scheduled | 80 percent |
| After the signing date, before the permit-fee charge was posted | Scheduled later | 80 percent |
| On the day the permit-fee charge was posted | Yes | 60 percent |
| After the day the permit-fee charge was posted | Yes | 60 percent |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical project signed on the 3rd, permit-fee charge posted on the 17th)

- Approval confirmed on the 3rd: 100 percent.
- Approval confirmed on the 16th: 80 percent.
- Approval confirmed on the 17th: 60 percent — the scheduling day itself counts as on or after scheduling.
- On the same project before any permit-fee charge is posted, an approval confirmed on the 10th: 80 percent.
